breakdown.description: The prompt makes the bending stress uniform through the depth, even though the flexure formula gives a linear stress distribution with zero stress at the neutral axis.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. The ground truth prompt corrects the original prompt by removing the physically incorrect instruction to treat bending stress as uniform. The agent, however, did the opposite; it explicitly repeated the flawed instruction ('The pure-bending normal stress is treated as uniform over the section depth') and proceeded to perform its calculations based on that incorrect premise. This directly contradicts the correction made in the ground truth.
